FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
At Sugar & Spice Desserts, we specialize in creating a delightful assortment of handmade desserts, including a variety of cakes, pastries, and frozen treats. Our operations focus on retail sales, aiming to provide our customers with high-quality, fresh products made from premium ingredients. We pride ourselves on maintaining rigorous food safety standards; our kitchen is regularly inspected to ensure compliance with health department regulations. Additionally, we offer limited alcohol service as a secondary feature, with all staff trained and certified in responsible alcohol service to guarantee a safe and enjoyable environment for our customers. Our experienced team is dedicated to maintaining a clean and welcoming space that enhances our guests' dessert experience.

Compliance Confirmation: The business does not engage in the service of alcohol and confirms full compliance with all requirements and best practices for dessert shops. All operations are focused on delivering high-quality desserts, and our staff possesses the necessary experience and training in the food service industry to ensure exceptional service. We are committed to maintaining a safe and responsible environment for our customers.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 09/15/2023, we incurred a loss of $500 due to an accidental water leak from the ceiling, which damaged a small section of our dessert display area. The incident has been resolved, and repairs were completed promptly. Status: Closed.
